items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. It also fixes CVE-2026-92909, a critical incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (B2B Unauthenticated Code Execution)
items.summary: Part of APSB26-153, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) affects Adobe Commerce B2B and allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe reports no exploitation in the wild for this specific vulnerability.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix addresses a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Adobe is aware of active exploitation of CVE-2026-75650 in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two critical stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3). Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that allows for customer account takeover without user interaction. Exploitation needs no existing account or administrator privileges.
